name: Local / Site Fabrication

activities: field-measure the actual gap: as-set nozzle position or tie-in point for field-fit/closure spools
fit-up in the fab yard or in-situ

sequence.note: Only for materials/thicknesses that require it.

activities: set closure spool into the gap
tested with the connecting system's hydrotest package

typical_relationships.before: set and align the connecting equipment / erect adjacent spools
typical_relationships.reason: the closure spool is measured against the real, as-built gap, not the drawing

typical_relationships.after: cut and weld the closure spool
typical_relationships.reason: fabricating before measuring risks a spool that does not fit the as-built condition
the weld must exist before inspection

typical_relationships.before: accept NDT of the closure spool
typical_relationships.after: include it in the hydrotest package
typical_relationships.reason: an unaccepted weld would fail the connecting system's pressure test
the line must be physically complete before it can be pressure-tested

typical_relationships.after: install the pipe or access they serve
typical_relationships.reason: supports and access steel are ready before the item they carry

interfaces.requirement: closure/tie-in spools bridge to as-set equipment nozzles — measured only after the equipment is set and aligned
strain-free tie-in spools measured after final alignment to protect nozzle loads
closure spools complete the erected line so it can be tested
closure spools complete utility lines for testing
overflow/complement to shop fabrication under the same QC regime
site-fabricated platforms, ladders and minor supports

testing_requirements: Same weld/NDT/PWHT/PMI regime as shop spools
Field-fit spool included in the connecting system's hydrotest package
Dimensional verification against the field measurement
commissioning_dependencies: Closure and tie-in spools installed and tested before the parent system can be pre-commissioned
Field-fit spools gate the completion of the line they close
typical_exceptions: Emergency/rework spools fabricated to correct clashes or failed fit-ups
Temporary spools/spades for flushing, removed at reinstatement
evidence: Field-fit closure and tie-in spools were measured only after the connecting equipment was set and aligned, then fabricated, NDT-accepted and installed to complete the line before it was hydrotested.
